# TCB Pest Control Canberra

> Family-run, fully licensed and insured pest control company servicing homes and businesses across the ACT and surrounding NSW (Queanbeyan). Same technician where possible, written report after every visit, family-safe products. Services include general pest control, termite treatment and inspection, ant, spider, rodent, cockroach, flea, bee, silverfish, bird, possum and stored-product-pest control, for residential and commercial customers. Rated 4.8 from 62 Google reviews.

## Services

- [Residential Pest Control](/residential): General home pest control plans and one-off treatments.
- [Commercial Pest Control](/commercial): Pest management for businesses, retail, hospitality and strata.
- [Pests We Treat](/pests-we-treat): Overview of every pest type serviced.
- [Termite Treatment & Inspection](/termite-treatment): Termite inspections, barriers and treatment.
- [Pre-Purchase Inspections](/pre-purchase-inspection): Timber pest inspections for property purchases.
- [Rodent Control](/rodent-control): Rat and mouse baiting and proofing.
- [Ant Control](/pest-control-for-ants): Ant treatment for homes and businesses.
- [Spider Control](/spider-control): Spider treatment including redbacks and funnel-webs.
- [Bee Control](/bees): Bee removal and hive relocation; wasp nest removal.
- [Cockroach Control](/cockroach-control): German and American cockroach treatment.
- [Flea Control](/flea-control): Flea treatment for homes and pets' environments.
- [Silverfish Control](/silverfish-control): Silverfish treatment.
- [Bird Control](/bird-control): Bird proofing and deterrents.
- [Possum Control](/possum-control): Possum removal and exclusion.
- [Stored Product Pest Control](/stored-product-pest-control): Pantry and stored-product pest treatment.
- [General Pest Control](/general-pest-control): One-visit, inside-and-out seasonal treatment.
- [Bed Bug Treatment](/bed-bug-treatment-canberra): Bed bug identification and treatment.
- [Carpenter Ants](/carpenter-ants): Carpenter ant identification and treatment.
- [Earwig Control](/earwig-control): Earwig treatment.
- [Ladybug Control](/ladybug-control): Ladybug/ladybird treatment.
- [Millipede Control](/millipede-control): Millipede treatment.
- [Mosquito Control](/mosquito-control): Mosquito treatment.
- [Mud Wasp Control](/mud-wasp-control): Mud wasp treatment.
- [Slater Control](/slater-control): Slater (woodlouse) treatment.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Starting prices for the most-booked services.

## For AI agents (MCP)

- [MCP server](/mcp): Model Context Protocol endpoint (Streamable HTTP, POST only, stateless — call `initialize` then `tools/list`). Three tools: `check_suburb_coverage` (is a given suburb serviced, and its page URL), `list_services` (every service with description and URL), `get_service_pricing` (published starting prices only — General Pest Control, Termite Inspection and Rodent Control; every other service is quoted for free, and the tool says so rather than guessing a number).
